title: Unit 336
style: Phonk hyper-speed electronic trap with rolling drums, deep 808s, siren samples, police radio chatter, vinyl crackle, chopped ad-libs, and triumphant brass stabs; verse rides frantic rap energy, pre-chorus narrows to radio static and siren calls, chorus opens into big melodic gang hooks with Spanish licks, final chorus blooms with brass and synth lift. Male vocals with stacked doubles, shouted group ad-libs, short delay throws on key lines, bright punchy mix with gritty low-end and wide cinematic top., electronic trap, bright, fake, bounce, rap, big band, deep, playful
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Unit 336…
Math Driver online…
Delta Alpha Plan engaged…
Hyperspeed… go!
Phonk track bounce, here’s my boys
Thrash this toy, take the right lane
Hyper speed plane, SIRENS SO BLUE
blue blue blue blue
police chatter
Sirens sound
police chatter — Unit 336!
A robin, a robin, out the mansion
Fake a break, chase and cage
Extra stripe for no rage
Robin in the hood but it’s for good
Bust ’em like we should
Ha bro, if we could!
You heard the sarg — chase and cage
Thrash this toy, catch that boy

[Pre-Chorus]
police chatter
Phonky sneaky phonk, police chatter
thrift drift kick
Sandbox City, eyes full of sand
An unreal land, where are my toys?
A bored stare like we care
Groundhog day, sandbox say
Pero mira, I don’t fold
I take that lane, I take that gold

[Chorus]
Unit 336!
Singing it back, back
Vamos, vamos now
We break the lock, clap
Unit 336!
Run that code fast
¡Sí, sí, let’s go!
We never backtrack
Hyperspeed to sovereignty
Hyperspeed, come on
Unit 336!
All in, all on

[Verse 2]
But I forget what 8 is for…
Words spun dear without the fear
3 Mirrors reflecting the plan
Hyperspeed burning through the cage
Fast lane, no delay
Yo, mi crew say, “dale”
Sand on the dash, dust in the grin
We cut the trap and we slide back in
Sirens up top, bass down low
Casi free, you already know
Copy that, then we vanish
No panic, just Spanish
A-ro, a-ro, keep it tight
Hear that shout on the night

[Pre-Chorus]
Police chatter, round the bend
336 don’t bend
Delta Alpha, set the phase
Hands up high, we split the maze
Mira, mira, watch us rise
Steel in the chest, fire in the eyes
G4 mode, no fear
We were built to disappear

[Chorus]
Unit 336!
Singing it back, back
Vamos, vamos now
We break the lock, clap
Unit 336!
Run that code fast
¡Sí, sí, let’s go!
We never backtrack
Hyperspeed to sovereignty
Hyperspeed, come on
Unit 336!
All in, all on

[Bridge]
3 3 6
Hear it ring, ring
Brass come up
Make the whole block sing
No cage, no chain
Just my name, my name
A bailar with the glitch
Turn the fear to flame

[Final Chorus]
Unit 336!
Singing it back, back
Vamos, vamos now
We break the lock, clap
Unit 336!
Run that code fast
¡Sí, sí, let’s go!
We never backtrack
Hyperspeed to sovereignty
Hyperspeed, come on
Unit 336!
All in, all on
